Talent0_2Ability.name: Sharpshooter
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When attacking with an Assault Weapon, if the Hit Rate is above <color=#F74848>90%</color>, all bullets are sure to hit.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Sharpshooter
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When attacking with an Assault Weapon, if the Hit Rate is above <color=#F74848>90%</color>, all bullets are sure to hit.
The weight of the Shotgun is reduced by <color=#F74848>125</color>.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200402.name: Warm-Up
200402.SpecificEffects: When attacking with an Assault Weapon, if no Miss occurs, gain <buf ID=2004022>[Hit UP]</buf> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

700033.name: Shooting Cans
700033.SpecificEffects: In combat, if the Hit Rate is above <color=#F74848>80%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200404.name: Hip Shot
200404.describe: Uses Shotgun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. Before combat, gains <buf ID=7100103>[Hit Rate UP II]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

700011.name: Backup Supply
700011.describe: Gain <color=#F74848>2</color> AP. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

200406.name: All Fired Up
200406.describe: Uses Shotgun to attack a target and deal <color=#F74848>1.4x</color> DMG. If all bullets hit, use the opposite arm to launch <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> after the enemy's retaliation, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5x</color> DMG.

200407.name: Gun Spinner
200407.SpecificEffects: When performing a perfect dodge, restore <color=#F74848>1 AP</color> after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200408.name: High Noon
200408.describe: Simultaneously uses 2 Shotguns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2* 0.9x</color> DMG and inflicting <buf ID=2004081>[Retaliation Disabled]</buf>.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

200441.name: Armed Escort 1
200441.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack in combat, every <color=#F74848>10%</color> Hit Rate converts to <color=#F74848>1.5%</color> Crit Rate, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

200444.name: Armed Escort 2
200444.SpecificEffects: When attacking with an Assault Weapon, if no Miss occurs, immediately gain Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+20%</color>, effective only for this combat.

200446.name: Armed Escort 4
200446.SpecificEffects: The trigger condition for <buf ID=2004501>[Sharpshooter]</buf> has been changed to a Hit Rate of <color=#F74848>80%</color> or higher.
